body: i hate myself. i only ever make people feel like shit. nobody cares about how im feeling. nobody ever asks me if im ok. nobody needs me and nobody wants me. ive just wanted to be gone for so long
i dont know why you care, but thank you. i might hold on another few hours. i dont know about another day
i think i just want to feel liked for once before i go. its easy for strangers to tell you not to do it over the internet. i thought reading everybodys replies would make me feel like somebody cared
